review_candidates.description: Test Engineer II – DNA Data Warehouse CSG’s vision is to deliver flexible, seamless, and limitless communications, information, and content services for everyone. We are looking for a Test Engineer II to join our DNA Data Warehouse team, part of CSG’s Advanced Convergent Platform (ACP) organization within the Data and Analytics portfolio. The DNA Data Warehouse supports CSG’s enterprise data warehouse product line, delivering scalable data solutions to several North American clients, with the platform primarily hosted in Snowflake on AWS. Our team designs, builds, and operates an end‑to‑end data platform that powers reporting, analytics, and downstream applications. We work with a modern technology stack including AWS, Snowflake, Qlik Replicate and Airflow to ingest, transform, and deliver large‑scale billing, customer, and operational data. You will be part of a fast‑paced data warehouse team responsible for securely and reliably sharing data with our customers using cutting‑edge technologies. Role Overview As a Test Engineer II focused on database and data‑driven products, you will be a key guardian of data quality, integrity, and performance. Your work will help ensure every release is stable, secure, and optimized, allowing our customers to trust the data they rely on. You will collaborate closely with developers, Scrum Masters, and Product Owners to proactively identify issues before they reach production, making you a critical contributor to our product success. Responsibilities Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans for database‑driven applications and services, including feature testing and automated regression testing. Validate data accuracy, schema integrity, and query performance across multiple environments. Develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts. Perform load, stress, and performance testing to ensure scalability under real‑world conditions. Partner with developers to reproduce, diagnose, and resolve defects efficiently. Document test results, create detailed defect reports, and track issues through resolution. Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to create and execute end‑to‑end test strategies. Analyse requirements and contribute to basic test design, development, and ongoing maintenance of manual and automated test suites as per the project needs. Perform both automated and manual testing, including functional, application, regression, and integration testing. Requirements 3+ years of experience in software testing, preferably with database products or data‑intensive applications. Strong SQL skills, including complex queries, joins, and stored procedures for testing and validation. Strong experience with relational databases such as Snowflake, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server; ETL/ELT experience is a plus. Hands‑on experience with automated testing frameworks and performance testing tools; prior experience with BDD frameworks like SpecFlow, Cucumber, or similar is highly desirable. Strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering high‑quality, reliable solutions. Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. A self‑motivated team player with a strong sense of ownership, commitment to quality, and desire for continuous learning. Prior experience using AI‑assisted tools for test automation and integrating them into daily testing activities is a plus. Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and systems. Strong analytical thinking and problem‑solving skills. Location(s): India Remote Accommodation: If you would like to be considered for employment opportunities with CSG and need special assistance due to a disability or accommodation for a disability throughout any aspect of the application process, please call us at +1 (402) 431-7440 or email us at accommodations@csgi.com. CSG provides accommodations for persons with disabilities in employment, including during the hiring process and any interview and/or testing processes. Our Guiding Principles: Impact: Always help and empower others, whether they’re colleagues or customers. When our employees set their minds to something, great things happen. Integrity: Do what’s right for our customers and our people while being authentic. We treat everyone with trust and respect—that’s just who we are. Inspiration: Be bold in the way you think and passionate about the work you do. Test out innovative ideas without the fear of failure. Our Story: CSG empowers companies to build unforgettable experiences, making it easier for people and businesses to connect with, use and pay for the services they value most. For over 40 years, CSG's technologies and people have helped some of the world's most recognizable brands solve their toughest business challenges and evolve to meet the demands of today's digital economy. By channeling the power of all, we make ordinary customer and employee experiences extraordinary. Our people [CSGers] are fearlessly committed and connected, high on integrity and low on ego, making us the easiest company to do business with and the best place to work. We power a culture of integrity, innovation, and impact across our locations, representing the most authentic version of ourselves to build a better future together. That's just who we are. Learn more about CSG Inclusion & Impact here.
